items.title: Met Police boss 'wouldn't be surprised' if more allegations made about Brand
items.summary: Sir Mark Rowley tells the BBC that what he heard reported from Brand's trial came close to "victim blaming".

items.title: Katherine Ryan feels 'grief and relief' over Brand guilty verdict
items.summary: Comedian Katherine Ryan has said she feels "grief and relief" after Russell Brand was convicted of rape and sexual assault.

items.title: Burnham responds to BBC question over Labour's links to Brand
items.summary: The prime minister says that Labour politicians courting the comedian a decade ago had not been aware of his crimes.

items.title: Two dead after bus carrying schoolchildren crashes in France, officials say
items.summary: A seven-year-old girl and an 18-year-old boy have been killed after a bus crashed in eastern France, French authorities said.

items.title: 'Misleading' student loans information left out examples of higher-salary repayments
items.summary: The Treasury Committee chair says she is "shocked" after one university compared repayments to the price of coffee.

items.title: Amateur cricketer 'Clicky Pointing' banned for two years over viral cheating
items.summary: An amateur cricketer dubbed 'Clicky Pointing' has been banned from the sport for two years over cheating during games.
